Phạm vi công việc: Đảm bảo hạ tầng công nghệ thông tin hoạt động ổn định, an toàn và hiệu quả. Quản trị và vận hành hệ thống mạng, máy chủ. Xử lý sự cố & hỗ trợ người dùng. Và các công việc khác theo phân công. 3. Chân dung ứng viên phù hợp: Học vấn: Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành CNTT, Mạng máy tính, Kỹ thuật máy tính hoặc liên quan. Kinh nghiệm: Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực quản trị hệ thống hoặc hạ tầng CNTT mô hình Tập đoàn và công ty thành viên. Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm thực tế trong vận hành hệ thống mạng và máy chủ doanh nghiệp vừa/lớn. Ưu tiên có chứng chỉ: CCNA, MCSA, VCP, Fortinet NSE, Azure/AWS Fundamentals… Yêu cầu chuyên môn: Hiểu rõ về mô hình mạng OSI, giao thức TCP/IP, subnetting, định tuyến và chuyển mạch. Có kinh nghiệm triển khai và quản trị hệ thống mạng LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, Firewall. Thành thạo cài đặt, cấu hình và vận hành hệ thống máy chủ (Windows/Linux) và ảo hóa (VMware, Hyper-V). Có hiểu biết về lưu trữ dữ liệu (SAN/NAS), hệ thống sao lưu – phục hồi (backup/restore). Có kinh nghiệm vận hành quản trị với các hệ thống Cloud (Azure, AWS), Hybrid Cloud, Private Cloud. Yêu cầu khác: Tư duy logic, cẩn thận và có trách nhiệm cao trong công việc, đặc biệt khi xử lý các sự cố ảnh hưởng đến hệ thống toàn doanh nghiệp. Chủ động, chịu khó học hỏi, cập nhật kiến thức công nghệ mới, sẵn sàng tiếp thu và áp dụng vào thực tiễn. Khả năng làm việc độc lập và làm việc nhóm tốt. 4. Quyền lợi và môi trường làm việc: Tại GEE, con người là yếu tố cốt lõi tạo nên thành công. Chúng tôi hướng đến xây dựng gói đãi ngộ tổng thể hấp dẫn (Total Compensation Package – TCP), không chỉ giúp thu hút và giữ chân nhân tài mà còn tạo điều kiện để mỗi cá nhân phát triển và đạt được thành tựu trong sự nghiệp. The role involves technical troubleshooting, team management, incident escalation, change management work, monitoring, and coordination with network/security/application/window/site support/ Local site contact Teams for support the business operation to avoid the business impact proactively. Essential Job Functions Lead and manage L1/L2 NOC engineers and coordinate daily operational activities. Ready to work from office in 24*7 shift it is also expected to handle technical and operational activities 70/30 respectively. Monitor network infrastructure, connectivity, and critical services using network monitoring tools. Handle and troubleshoot P1/P2/P3 incidents and ensure timely resolution according to SLA. Provide L2 technical support for network and server -related issues and coordinate with vendors/carriers when required. Troubleshoot LAN, WAN, VLAN, routing, switching, VPN, Internet, and firewall connectivity issues. Troubleshoot STP, VLAN, trunk, EtherChannel/LACP, ARP, MAC-table, and interface-related issues. Monitor and troubleshoot MPLS, SD-WAN, leased lines, broadband, and site-to-site connectivity. Work with network security teams on Palo Alto/Cisco firewalls, security policies, NAT, IPsec VPN, and access requests. Manage and troubleshoot Cisco Meraki, Juniper SDWAN network infrastructure and firmware upgrade activities. Perform incident analysis using monitoring tools, logs etc. Lead troubleshooting bridges during major incidents and provide regular updates to stakeholders. Coordinate with ISP, application, server, security, and cloud teams for cross-functional issues. Review network alerts and identify recurring issues and potential problems. Perform change management, including network upgrades, configuration changes, migrations, and maintenance activities. Ensure changes follow approved ITIL processes, including RFC, risk assessment, implementation, validation, and rollback planning. Communicate incident status, risks, and resolutions to customers and management. Drive RCA reviews and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented. Review team performance, provide coaching, and mentor junior engineers. Ensure effective shift handovers and operational continuity across 24×7 support. Lead infrastructure and server outage management to minimize business impact and service disruption. review_candidates.description: About Smart System Smart System is a leading IT System Integrator operating across Egypt, MENA, and Africa since 2007, delivering advanced solutions in Data Centers, Networking, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, and Enterprise Systems. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Customer Solution Architect – Network & Security to design and develop enterprise-level networking and cybersecurity solutions. The role involves understanding customer requirements, designing end-to-end technical architectures, leading presales activities, and supporting the sales team in delivering competitive technology solutions for enterprise customers. Key Responsibilities Design and architect enterprise networking and cybersecurity solutions based on customer business and technical requirements. Lead technical discovery sessions, customer meetings, workshops, and solution presentations. Develop High-Level and Low-Level Designs (HLD/LLD), technical proposals, BOMs, BOQs, and solution architecture documents. Analyze RFPs, RFQs, and RFI requirements and prepare comprehensive technical responses. Design and propose enterprise network solutions, including LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, Routing, and Switching. Architect security solutions covering Next-Generation Firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS, NAC, Zero Trust, and network segmentation. Integrate networking and security solutions with Data Center, Cloud, and Hybrid IT environments. Collaborate with Sales, Presales, and Technical Delivery teams throughout the sales cycle. Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), technical demonstrations, and vendor engagements. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through integrated technology solutions. Technical Requirements Strong technical knowledge and practical architecture experience in several of the following areas: Networking & Infrastructure Enterprise Routing & Switching (BGP, OSPF, VLANs, MPLS). LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, and Data Center Networking. Network Virtualization, High Availability, and Load Balancing. Network Security & Cybersecurity Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW). IDS/IPS, VPN, NAC, and Network Segmentation. ZTNA, SASE, and Zero Trust Architecture. WAF, Endpoint Security, EDR/XDR, and SIEM. Network Security Monitoring and Vulnerability Management. Cloud & Data Center Data Center Network Architecture and Spine-Leaf Design. Hybrid Cloud and Multi-Cloud Networking. VMware NSX or equivalent virtualization technologies. AWS and Microsoft Azure networking fundamentals. Preferred Vendor Technologies Networking: Cisco, HPE Aruba, Juniper, Huawei. Security: Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, Cisco, Sophos. Data Center: Dell Technologies, HPE, VMware. Security Platforms: Microsoft Security, CrowdStrike, Trend Micro, IBM Security. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in Networking, Network Security, Solution Architecture, or Presales. Proven experience in an IT System Integrator, technology solutions provider, or enterprise IT environment. Strong experience designing enterprise networking and cybersecurity solutions. Experience handling enterprise customers and large-scale IT projects. Excellent knowledge of technical proposals, HLD/LLD, BOQs, and RFP/RFQ processes. Strong customer-facing, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills. Excellent English communication skills. Preferred Certifications Cisco CCNP / CCIE. Fortinet FCP / FCSS. Palo Alto PCNSE. Check Point CCSA / CCSE. AWS Solutions Architect / Azure Certifications. CISSP / CISM. What We Offer Opportunity to work with leading global technology vendors. Exposure to enterprise-level projects across multiple industries. Professional development and technical certification opportunities. Career growth opportunities across Egypt and the MENA region. Potential relocation opportunities to Saudi Arabia based on business requirements.

review_candidates.title: System Engineer – L2 | Bengaluru
review_candidates.description: System Engineer – L2 Company: Worksent Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka About the Role Worksent is seeking an experienced System Engineer – L2 to provide on-site IT support for our Australia-based client at their Bengaluru office. The ideal candidate will have strong technical troubleshooting skills, hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and Windows environments, and a customer-focused approach to IT service delivery. The role involves managing day-to-day IT operations, resolving Level 2 technical issues, maintaining IT infrastructure, and coordinating with the client’s Australian team to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery. The company prefers immediate joiners or candidates who can join within 2–3 weeks . Candidates with a notice period of up to one month may also be considered. Excellent communication skills are essential for this role. Please go through the job description , and if it matches your profile, kindly apply. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary on-site IT point of contact, handling desk-side and remote support requests within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Manage the Microsoft 365 user lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, licensing, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and sign-in issues. Deploy, configure, and support Windows devices using Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot. Handle on-site hardware requirements, including device deployments, replacements, peripherals, and printer troubleshooting. Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and internet connectivity issues. Perform structured cabling activities, including cable installation, termination, testing, rack patching, and labelling. Investigate and triage security alerts, quarantined emails, and application allow-listing requests. Maintain accurate ticket notes, provide timely updates, and communicate technical issues clearly to our Australian client team. Escalate complex issues with detailed troubleshooting notes and clear handover documentation. Maintain IT documentation and adhere to established support processes and security standards. Required Skills and Qualifications Minimum 4 years of IT support experience , including hands-on Level 2 support. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and Windows 10/11. Experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot. Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, Wi-Fi, and VPN. Hands-on experience with structured cabling, including Cat6 cable installation, RJ45/keystone termination, testing, and rack patching. Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate effectively with non-technical users and overseas stakeholders. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and customer service skills. Professional and calm communication, with a customer-focused approach. Good organisational skills, accountability, and attention to detail in ticket management and documentation. Preferred Skills Experience with any of the following will be an added advantage: Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments. Supporting international clients or distributed teams. NinjaOne, ThreatLocker, Hudu, or UniFi networking solutions. Apply Now If you have the required technical expertise and are interested in supporting our Australia-based client from Bengaluru, we encourage you to apply.
